caption: The drawing features two distinct metal pitchers centered vertically on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher at the top is cylindrical with a slightly outward-flaring rim and a rounded handle on the right side; it is dark brown or black, with a decorative band near the upper portion consisting of red and yellow flower or petal shapes interspersed with green leaves and a scalloped yellow border below the decoration. The second pitcher, positioned beneath the first, has a conical body with a small spout on the left side and a curved handle on the right. It is also dark colored, displaying a circular, multicolored design on its side featuring red, yellow, and green, and is bordered by a similar scalloped green pattern below the painted motif. Both pitchers cast faint shadows to the lower right, indicating a light source from the upper left of the composition. The background is unadorned and smooth, focusing attention entirely on the two pitchers.
title: Tin Cup and Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
